description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate PhotoAlbum photo storage from local file system to Azure Blob Storage while preserving current upload and photo retrieval behavior.
tasks.reason: The current local file storage does not align with Azure-native storage requirements for modernization.
tasks.requirements: Replace local file persistence for uploaded photos with Azure Blob Storage and keep user-visible behavior equivalent for upload, read, and delete operations. Use managed identity based authentication for Blob access and avoid storage keys or connection strings.

tasks.description: Scan project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities before finalizing modernization changes.
tasks.reason: Security validation is required for every modernization plan to reduce known dependency risk.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to patched versions and document any major-version upgrade risk when required. Verify the project builds and existing tests pass after remediation.
